top_call_exchanges.topic: Unity 6 Launch & Runtime Fee Overhang Resolution

top_call_exchanges.topic: Operating Leverage & Free Cash Flow Durability

top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Mark Barrysmith (Interim CFO): 'Yes. We executed rigorous cost discipline, trimmed excess layers, and reduced SBC from 20% to 10% of revenue. Our high gross margin (82%) provides massive operating leverage as top-line scale expands.'
